== Closing Blessing ==
Life within Gaia is endlessly complex, and as limited beings we can be overwhelmed by the complexity.  May we share this burden and be grateful for the many allies who are working to make this spectacularly complex biosphere function.  May we add our particular distinctiveness to the whole.  --Blessed Be
